method.selection: Exactly the eight validation-final runs on formal-unseen-20261113-09 through -16
method.floor: Reconstruct original base fee from reference fee, supply weighting and configured fee. Money scenarios hold accepted orders and driver behavior fixed; they are not causal profit estimates.
method.conservativeSubset: Original floor binds, road distance <=35 km, weighted eligible home supply >=30, on time, total driver fees equal opening fee, and no order_changed event.
method.destinationHome: Profile-qualified home within35 roadkm of destination and >100 roadkm from pickup; thus excluded by the original pickup-only offer radius.
method.timing: Static potential reach from the order_won time to original public lastPickupAt. Scenarios use road time+10, twice road time+30, and three times road time+60 minutes; these are travel proxies, not public-transport schedules or driver availability.
caveats: Daily willingness to work, remaining daily gig capacity, actual location and notification probability are unobserved.
No counterfactual fee acceptance or cost saving is observable in these logs.
Reducing base fees also reduces adaptive customer quotes unless fee and customer-cost experiments are separated.
Manual requirements are read from reveal truth only for this retrospective analysis; deployment must use the note parser.
